name: lispnt
description: Lispnt - a gentle, read-only diagnostic path for Common Lisp (SBCL), alongside OLIVE.

lispnt.enable.description: Check Lisp files and report mistakes in the Problems panel.

lispnt.debounceMs.description: How long to wait after an edit before checking the file again.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Open a Lisp file to see the calls its ;;[trace] markers name.
[Show Trace](command:lispnt.showTrace)
